additional_info.body:
Hello Cenoiu, good afternoon.
Thank you for reporting this issue. There seems to be a wrong status being displayed on the backend and as such, confusing to you. We have already reported this issue to the development team to understand the root cause and find a fix for it.
I checked via Sifinity Control and the updates are reaching properly, we just got an update a few minutes ago:
I can tell you that the charger is fully functional as I can access it remotely.
Please let me know if this has answered to your questions. Always make sure via the Events tab if the charger is indeed getting updates.
I will wait for your feedback before I close the ticket since we have nothing else to provide. If you keep facing this issue, please raise a ticket so that we can confirm that it's nothing wrong.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
